analysis.reasoning: The cited figure19 path only runs iterative_SA.py with speed-up off/on and draw.py. draw.py parses training-time and total-time log entries and plots training time; it does not invoke a compiled-model profiling path or measure inference latency/memory. This matches the finding that the artifact path lacks compiled latency/memory measurement.
